title: Fire Vault
subtitle: Jahannan Vault, entrance to the Major Smoldering Stone

notes.title: Pressure plate trap
notes.body: The pressure plate by the chest sets off a Magic trap that casts Nullify All Magic Other, which strips your buffs. The chest is unlocked and holds one random tier 3 item.

notes.title: Magma
notes.body: Magma on the floor of the level below the stone room burns for fire damage. Stay on the route.

notes.title: Use frost
notes.body: Cold hits everything here: Flamma, Ember and Inferno take 65-100%, Enku Zefir 75% and Direland Rats 58%. Fire does almost nothing (0-1%, rats 25%).

notes.title: Stone and note
notes.body: Give the Major Smoldering Stone to Zahir in Stonehold (68.7N 21.5W) for a Writ of Refuge. The Carefully Printed Note is in High Empyrean and can't be read without a translator.
